title: FOODEEG: An open dataset of human electroencephalographic and behavioural responses to food images
description: FOODEEG is an open dataset of electroencephalographic (EEG) and behavioural responses to food images from 117 participants across two testing sessions. Session 1 involved a food categorisation task with continuous EEG recording, while Session 2 comprised a food go/no-go task and a food paired choice task, along with questionnaires on dietary style and eating motivations. The dataset also includes normative ratings on 22 food attributes collected from an independent online sample (N = 624), providing a rich resource for studying neural and behavioural correlates of food-related decision-making.
methods_description: EEG was recorded continuously during a food categorisation task in which participants viewed food images for 2 s and judged healthiness, tastiness, or willingness to eat. Each image was presented three times, once per judgment category. In a second session, participants completed a food go/no-go task and a food paired choice task, plus questionnaires assessing dietary style, eating motivations, and hedonism. Raw EEG data are provided in BioSemi (.bdf) format with accompanying events.tsv files, and cleaned continuous EEG derivatives (.set) are provided for 110 participants after exclusion of 7 participants.
